in_sanskrit.name: मनुज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is born as a human being. The term 'manav' is derived from this name.

in_marathi.name: Manuj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Man: Human. Uj: Born.
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manuj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Manuj is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a combination of two words, Man and Uj. Man means human, and Uj means born. Therefore, the name Manuj can be translated to mean 'human born'.
